hooks.name: Remind to apply the design when editing the palette
hooks.description: When the design table is saved, regenerate tokens.css and sync the PWA if the project has already been generated.

action.prompt: The file .kiro/specs/01-system-design/design.md was saved. If pwa/src/styles/tokens.css exists (the portal has already been generated), compare the values in the "Palette (edit here)" section with that file; if they differ, rewrite pwa/src/styles/tokens.css and web/src/styles/tokens.css (identical) with the same structure, run the apply-palette block inline (python3 - <<'PY', without saving files), report any contrast WARNING and remind the user to close and reopen the installed app (service worker in pwa/; the web app only needs a reload). If tokens.css does not exist yet, do nothing: the palette will be applied when spec 01 is run.
